title: Geoffrey Hinton leaves Google and warns about the dangers of advanced AI
summary: Analytics Vidhya reports that the deep-learning pioneer left Google and spoke publicly about future AI risks.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: Hollywood writers begin a strike, with limits on AI in writing among their stated goals
summary: The Writers Guild of America started its strike on 2 May 2023, and one stated goal was to limit the use of AI in the writing process.
srcName: Wikipedia: 2023 Writers Guild of America strike

title: Google introduces PaLM 2, a language model with stronger multilingual, reasoning and coding skills
summary: At Google I/O 2023 Google presented PaLM 2, which it is building into its products.

title: Anthropic expands Claude's context window from 9K to 100K tokens
summary: Anthropic said the larger window lets businesses submit long documents and hold extended conversations with Claude.

title: European Parliament committees back an AI Act negotiating mandate by 84 votes to 7, with 12 abstentions
summary: The Internal Market and Civil Liberties committees endorsed risk-based rules that would ban uses such as some biometric surveillance and social scoring, pending a plenary vote.

title: US Senate subcommittee hears OpenAI's Sam Altman, IBM's Christina Montgomery and Gary Marcus on AI oversight
summary: The Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Privacy, Technology, and the Law, chaired by Richard Blumenthal, held the hearing 'Oversight of A.I.: Rules for Artificial Intelligence'.

title: Yandex unveils YandexGPT and adds a skill for it to its voice assistant Alisa
summary: Yandex presented its language model YandexGPT, which users can try through a new skill in the Alisa assistant.

title: Meta unveils its first in-house AI chips
summary: Analytics Vidhya reports that Meta released its first two AI chips.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: OpenAI publishes 'Governance of superintelligence', proposing coordination among developers and an international inspection body
summary: The post argues that future superintelligent systems need special governance and continued safety research, while smaller models should be exempt.

title: Nvidia reports record data-centre revenue of USD 4.28bn and guides next quarter to USD 11bn
summary: Nvidia posted first-quarter fiscal 2024 revenue of USD 7.19bn, down 13% year on year, and projected USD 11.00bn for the next quarter.

title: Hundreds of AI experts and public figures sign the Center for AI Safety statement on extinction risk from AI
summary: The statement says mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority.

title: Nvidia's market value passes USD 1 trillion during trading
summary: Wikipedia records that Nvidia crossed a USD 1 trillion valuation during trading hours in May 2023.
